heading: Short title, extent and commencement
title: Short title, extent and commencement
text:
1. Short title, extent and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the National Book Foundation Act, 1972.

(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.

(3) It shall come into force at once.

heading: Definitions
title: Definitions
text:
2.  Definitions. In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,—
(a) “books” shall include textbooks, reference books and other books on religion and other books and reading material for use by students and the general public;
and
(b) “Foundation” means the Foundation established under this Act.

heading: Establishment of the Foundation
title: Establishment of the Foundation
text:
3.  Establishment of the Foundation.—(1) As soon as may be after the commencement of this Act, the Federal Government may, for the purpose of making books available at moderate prices, by notification in the official Gazette, establish a National Book Foundation, hereinafter referred to as the Foundation.

(2) The Foundation shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to acquire, hold and dispose of property, both movable and immovable.

3.  Establishment of the Foundation.—(1) As soon as may be after the commencement of 
this Act, the Federal Government may, for the purpose of making books available at moderate prices, 
by notification in the official Gazette, establish a National Book Foundation, hereinafter referred to as

(2) The Foundation shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal

heading: Functions of the Foundation
title: Functions of the Foundation
raw_text:
6. Functions of the Foundation. The following shall be the functions of the Foundation, 
namely:—  
(a)  
to receive any money or financial grants from the Federal Government, the 
Provincial Governments, local bodies and any statutory or non-statutory 
corporation;  
(b)  
to collect, accept or otherwise receive from any person, body, association, 
institution or organization any subscription or donation made to the Founda- 
tion;  
(c)  
to undertake writing of books and to encourage writers to produce good books;  
(d)  
to undertake the translation of foreign and locally-produced books into the 
national and regional languages of the country and vice versa; 
(e)  
to arrange the original publication and re-production of local books as well as 
those published abroad;  
(f)  
to import foreign books and to undertake the distribution of books among the 
educational institutions and the general public;  
(g)  
to encourage the writers and the book trade in general in the production of books 
and making them available to the students and the general public at moderate 
prices;  
(h)  
to provide technical know-how and financial assistance and to take other steps 
aimed at fostering interest in books and in reading; and

(i)  
to initiate such other activities and programmes as may assist in the task of book 
development, book promotion, advancement of literacy and dissemination of 
knowledge by means of the printed word.

heading: Audit
title: Audit
text: 7. Audit. The accounts of the Foundation shall be audited annually by the Auditor- General of Pakistan and the balance-sheet and statements of assets and liabilities shall be duly considered by the Board of Governors.

Board of Governors.
